title: 第9章 今日必须下山第10章 虚构的记忆
slug: 太古神墟第1974章药园小酌
content_zh:
“这不是几年前从大红鸟那里弄来的蛋吗？不是装在玉盒里吗？怎么跑灵石堆里了？”
落尘双手捧起硕大的蛋。
学过各种宝物的鉴别，葫芦里收集的绝大多数宝物，落尘基本都知晓名字及用途。
极个别的除外，其中就有这颗蛋。
这颗蛋像墨色的玉石，无比坚硬。
里面似乎有生命的气息。
当年，落尘也是好奇，才从大红鸟手里讹诈过来。
据大红鸟说，蛋是她偶然得到的，孵化了几百年，没有丝毫变化。
这蛋还偷吃她很多灵石灵果等宝物。
落尘当时不信。
“看来大红鸟没有骗我，上次我丢的灵果灵药也与这蛋有关，可是这里面究竟是什么东西呢？”
上次丢了很多灵药，怀疑是这颗蛋所为，落尘很气愤。
用刀砍，用火烧，用水煮，可这颗蛋没有丝毫变化。
“算了，自认倒霉吧。
这回我给你封印，看你还怎么偷吃。”
没有什么好办法对付这颗蛋，不知道有什么用，还总偷东西，扔了又舍不得，只能如此。
落尘捧着蛋，走到了一个角落。
角落里有个大玄铁柜子，里面放着一些他不能识别的宝贝。
有四岁的时候，从师尊的一个翠绿枝条上偷的两片树叶；
有六岁时从大乌鸦那里讹诈过来的能发热的红石头；

有前年征战时发现的一块拳头大小，却无比沉重的矿石；
还有去年征战时收集到的一个刻满神秘符文的残破碎片。
……
正因为不知道的这些东西有什么用，才视为宝贝，单独用玄铁柜存放。
落尘拿出一个玉盒，把蛋装进去。
又在玉盒外面贴了几道灵符，把玉盒放进玄铁柜。
灵符是三师姐清婉制作的，专门用来封印，很好用。
“小白，你说这蛋里真有活着的东西？”
落尘问缠在手臂上的小白蛇。
小白蛇点点头。
“你知道是什么东西吗？怎么才能让他出来？”
落尘又问。
小白蛇摇摇头。
“唉，你也不知道。
弄不明白就不去想了，以后不吃我灵石就行。”
落尘嘀咕道，出了葫芦空间。
刚出空间，腰间的传音石就响了，师尊让他立即回去。
一间竹屋里，白衣女子端坐案前，面沉似水。
清婉和紫嫣站在一旁，低头啜泣。
“师尊，怎么了？我这几天也没惹祸啊，也没领师姐她们干坏事啊？”

跑进来的落尘一脸不解。
“小师弟，师尊不要我们三个了，呜呜……”
content_en:
"Isn't this the egg we got from the big red bird a few years ago? Isn't it packed in a jade box? Why did it end up in the pile of spiritual stones?"
Luochen held the huge egg in his hands.
Having learned how to identify various treasures, Luo Chen basically knew the names and uses of most of the treasures collected in the gourd.
Except for a few exceptions, including this egg.
This egg is like dark jade, extremely hard.
There seemed to be a breath of life inside.
Back then, Luochen was also curious, so he blackmailed him from Big Red Bird.
According to the big red bird, she got the egg by chance and it has been hatched for hundreds of years without any change.
This egg also stole many of her spiritual stones, spiritual fruits and other treasures.
Luochen didn't believe it at the time.
"It seems that the big red bird didn't lie to me. The spiritual fruit and elixir I lost last time is also related to this egg, but what exactly is in it?"
A lot of elixirs were lost last time, and I suspected that this egg was responsible. Luochen was very angry.
He chopped it with a knife, burned it with fire, and boiled it with water, but the egg didn't change at all.
“Forget it, consider yourself unlucky.
This time I will seal it for you and see how you continue to eat it. "
There is no good way to deal with this egg. I don't know what it is used for. I always steal things and can't bear to throw them away. I can only do this.
Luochen held the egg and walked to a corner.
There was a large black iron cabinet in the corner, containing some treasures that he could not identify.
When I was four years old, I stole two leaves from one of the master's green branches;
There is the red stone that generates heat that was blackmailed from the crow when he was six years old;
There was a piece of fist-sized but extremely heavy ore discovered during the expedition the year before last;
There is also a broken fragment engraved with mysterious runes collected during last year's battle.
…
Precisely because I don't know what the use of these things is, I treat them as treasures and store them in separate black iron cabinets.
Luochen took out a jade box and put the eggs in it.
A few more talismans were pasted on the outside of the jade box, and the jade box was put into the black iron cabinet.
The magic talisman was made by Third Senior Sister Qingwan. It is specially used for sealing and is very useful.
"Xiao Bai, do you think there is really something alive in this egg?"
Luochen asked the little white snake wrapped around his arm.
The little white snake nodded.
"Do you know what it is? How can I get him out?"
Luochen asked again.
The little white snake shook his head.
"Oh, you don't know either.
If you don't understand it, don't think about it. Just don't eat my spiritual stone in the future. "
Luochen muttered and left the gourd space.
As soon as he left the space, the sound transmission stone on his waist rang, and the master asked him to go back immediately.
In a bamboo house, a woman in white was sitting in front of the desk, her face as sinking as water.
Qingwan and Ziyan stood aside, lowering their heads and sobbing.
"Master, what's wrong? I haven't caused any trouble in the past few days, nor have I led my senior sisters or others to do bad things?"
Luochen, who ran in, looked puzzled.
"Junior brother, Master doesn't want the three of us anymore, wuwu..."
